override.repo_standard: store.py module docstring: 'mirrors the fit_store.py / wear/store.py precedent of a standalone artifact store' — an established repo pattern of one store class per artifact family with parallel insert_X/load_X method pairs per table (4 near-identical pairs here: weekend_state, car_basis_posteriors, lap_evidence, feature_view_rows), all funneling through the shared generic _insert/_load helpers that already de-duplicate the actual SQL-shape logic.
override.reason: The per-table insert_X/load_X wrapper pairs are thin (3-6 lines each) and exist for a stable, named public surface per table -- the real duplication risk (SQL construction, JSON (de)serialization, natural-key handling) is already factored into the single generic _insert/_load pair every wrapper delegates to. Collapsing the 4 named wrapper pairs into one generic method would trade a stable, discoverable per-table API for indirection the project's own established store precedent (fit_store.py/wear/store.py) deliberately does not take.

override.repo_standard: G1's own store.py: load_as_of(year, gp_name, constructor, as_of_session) and every insert_*/load_* pair already establish (year, gp_name, constructor[, session_type, model_version]) as the natural-key parameter clump threaded positionally through the whole package -- build_feature_view_row and read_feature_view (this gate) carry the identical clump forward, not a new one.
override.reason: Bundling this recurring 4-6-field natural key into a value object was available to G1 and was not chosen; introducing one now, in the closing gate, for two functions that must match the established signature shape of every sibling function in the package (load_as_of, insert_car_basis_posterior's underlying record, etc.) would be exactly the kind of after-the-fact speculative abstraction global-crew.md's 'no speculative abstraction' rule warns against -- it does not pay for itself against 2 more call sites of an already-repo-wide pattern.

override.repo_standard: records.py module docstring: axis_values/axis_sigma/axis_status 'are DICTS keyed by axis name (not fixed columns) because the ... physics axes are a configurable list at this layer, not a hardcoded schema' -- and session_type/constructor/gp_name are validated bare strings via records.session_ordinal's fail-visibly ValueError convention (mirrors fp_gate_real_extractor.nominal_hours_to_q), not silently trusted.
override.reason: The bare-str/dict shapes here are a deliberate, explicitly-documented design choice (configurable axis list; fail-visible session validation), not an unexamined default -- introducing wrapper types for session_type/constructor would add ceremony the project's own explicit-unknown/fail-visibly conventions (CREW_CONTEXT.md 'Data Semantics') already satisfy without one.

override.repo_standard: load_as_of(year, gp_name, constructor, as_of_session) (G1) already fixed a 4-positional-plus-self signature shape for every as-of-scoped package function; build_feature_view_row/read_feature_view (5-6 params: store, year, gp_name, constructor, as_of_session, model_version) match that established shape exactly, keying model_version as keyword-only in build_feature_view_row.
override.reason: Each parameter is an independent, semantically distinct axis of the natural key (not a smuggled flag-bag) and the count matches every sibling function already in the package -- consolidating into a parameter object here alone would fork the calling convention for 2 of N package functions rather than the whole package, which is out of this gate's allowed scope (G1-G4's records.py/store.py signatures are CLOSED per Specific Exclusions).
